main.label: Three cave trolls next to a healthy Warrior wielding the Axe of Eönwë
main.explanation: A level-35 Warrior with 431 hit points wields the Great Axe of Eönwë, whose activation banishes evil monsters, and three awake cave trolls stand next to it (danger 138). The production defence routine chooses a defence. Original: the artifact test reads an unrelated object-kind count, is false, and the Banishment defence is not available; the Borg quaffs a Potion of Berserk Strength (value 5). Corrected: the Borg activates the axe and banishes the three trolls (value 138).
